newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Southland Power Company lifts half yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Southland Power Company lifts half yr profit.

text.p: Southland's The Power Company on Tuesday announced a net profit of $2.36 million for the six months to December 31, 1996, compared with a net profit of $792,000 for the corresponding period in 1995.
Directors reported that the profit represented a 7.2 percent return on shareholders funds and was close to the rate targeted in the statement of intent.
It represented an acceptable level after a disappointing result for the 12 months to June 1996, they said.
They predicted a flattening out of trends into the second half, and, subject to unforeseen events, projected a net profit of $2.4 million for the full year.

Chief executive Keith McConnell said the Monowai hydro station produced 22.5gwh of electricity in the period, compared with 24gwh for the same period last year, with profitability slightly ahead of last year.
